searchText: Sorry for the question. I tried to find where the decision was made but couldn't. For eip7549, is the plan to keep `AttestationData` unchanged and just keep the committee index 0? Ignore my question. I found the answer in p2p and validator specs. Also opened: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3669 > more than a couple of characters hurt This likely because of your strong math background 😜 The plan is to keep 0 to avoid changing the container Hi, have a question about the slashing protection ref tests https://github.com/eth-clients/slashing-protection-interchange-tests . Currently adding them to Teku but there was a versioned tests directory `tar.gz` in previous releases, but this is no longer the case. Has it possibly been missed to add them? It would make life easier to run the tests.
